title: platform-deps
description: Everything an app must have before it starts. `additionalProperties: false` everywhere it is modelled: a typo'd values key that silently does nothing is the most common Helm failure mode, and this file is the only thing that catches it (10-verification.md, "Schema validation"). Env-name profiles (`env: canonical|django|...`) are plain strings here rather than an enum — `platform.profile` already fails naming every profile it has, and a list in two places is a list that drifts.

global.description: Helm's own passthrough to subcharts. Modelled only so declaring it is not an error.

platform-lib.description: Helm coalesces a key per dependency into the parent's values, so this one is present on every render whether or not anyone writes it. Without it `additionalProperties: false` rejects the chart's own defaults.

platform.description: Where the 30-platform layer put the shared datastores. Defaults, not knobs.

uses.description: Which instances this app needs. Every entry must name a key of `instances`.

credentialSecret.description: The ASSEMBLED Secret, not the generate-once one that feeds it.

username.description: Defaults to `app`. The OpenSearch internal user.

indexPrefix.description: Defaults to `app`. The tenant boundary — the app's role grants `<indexPrefix>-*` and nothing else (adr/0111).

mode.description: `garage` provisions on the platform's store; `external` reads endpoint, region and credential from `credentialSecret` in the office-data store.

globalAlias.description: Defaults to the bucket; set explicitly when restoring data.

publicEndpoint.description: Where a BROWSER reaches this bucket — only correct for an app that presigns to the browser, and only if the store is published there (adr/0110). Rendered through `tpl`.

client.description: Defaults to `app`; also names the Keycloak client.

smtp.description: The outbound relay. Everything about it — host, port, TLS flags, credentials and the from-address — lives in `credentialSecret`, applied by hand into office-data (docs/bootstrap.md); nothing here names a mail server.

backend.description: Django's EMAIL_BACKEND class. A constant, carried in the Secret beside the host it points at.

credentialSecret.description: The hand-applied Secret in the office-data store. Not generated — a relay account is issued by somebody else.

generated.description: Secret name -> an ORDERED list of variables, each with its own draw (adr/0005, adr/0106). A map would let Helm's key sort silently rewrite `dataFrom`, and these objects cannot gain a variable once drawn.

generator.description: ClusterGenerator for this draw; default platform.passwordGenerator

duration.description: An ESO refreshInterval: a Go duration, or "0" for written-once-never-again.
